					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m164_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m164_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m164_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m164_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					trigger_else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m164_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					trigger_else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_cross_team_evidence value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_cross_team_evidence value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_object_case value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_object_state value = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_candidate_share value = 40 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_peer_share value = 60 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_share_check value = 100 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_candidate_share value = 100 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_peer_share value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_attribution_debt value = 1 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m164_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m164_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m164_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m164_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m164_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m164_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m164_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m164_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m164_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m164_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m164_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m164_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m164_cross_team_evidence
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_u_revision }

		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m164_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m164_cross_team_evidence } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_u_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 1 } }

		zg361_pp_u_try_advance_02_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m164_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m164_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m164_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_audit_1_expected_state value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m164_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2164 days = 90 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2164 days = 90 } }
	}
}
